name: OVARP-Server
install: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y python3.12-venv && python3 -m venv venv && ./venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && ./venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt -r requirements_dev.txt

terminals.name: server
terminals.description: OVARP FastAPI server and Wizard-of-Oz console on http://localhost:8000. Set OPENAI_API_KEY / GEMINI_API_KEY secrets to enable live LLM/STT/TTS; the console and session tooling run without them.
